channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: ‘Hormuz remains blocked’: Iran disputes Trump claims as traffic sinks to near 3-month lows
item.description: The Persian Strait Gulf Authority said "the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked and will not be reopened until Iran's conditions are accepted."

item.title: South Korea’s Kospi has staged a stunning comeback. How long will the bull market last?
item.description: South Korea's Kospi has staged a reversal from its latest rout, returning to bull-market territory as investors piled back into the semiconductor giants that dominate the index.

item.title: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
item.description: Cerebras Systems reported better-than-expected second-quarter revenue and raised its full-year guidance.

item.title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await more inflation data: Live updates
item.description: The July reading of the producer price index, which gauges what wholesalers pay for raw goods and materials, is set for release Thursday at 8:30 a.m. ET.

item.title: This Chinese firm has topped Micron and Kioxia in shipments of crucial NAND memory chips
item.description: Counterpoint Research looked at the NAND segment of memory chips, which is benefitting along with the larger DRAM segment from artificial intelligence demand.

item.title: Trump says Karoline Leavitt resigning as White House press secretary
item.description: Leavitt, the youngest White House press secretary ever, gave birth in May to a girl, her second child.

item.title: Everything is going right for the financials sector. Why that is
item.description: Financials are running away as a group, with just about every corner offering something compelling for investors.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Why global funds are flocking to GIFT City in Modi’s home state
item.description: Favorable regulations, a growing local investor base, and tax holidays are giving momentum to India's GIFT City.

item.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
item.description: Beyond the big single-month jump, the collective red ink over the 10 months of the fiscal year rose to nearly $1.8 trillion, surpassing the same period in 2025.

item.title: South Korea's Kospi swings from bear to bull-market territory in just over a month on AI trade
item.description: South Korean stocks rallied on Thursday, pushing the benchmark Kospi into a technical bull market.

item.title: Goldman says Japan's $1 trillion of reserves leaves 'plenty of capacity' for further yen interventions
item.description: Japan has enough cash at its disposal for a couple more rounds of yen-buying on the scale of last month's intervention, Goldman Sachs says.

item.title: Saudi Arabia ramps up oil exports through Mediterranean pipeline to avoid attacks in Red Sea
item.description: Oil exports from Egypt's Mediterranean port of Sidi Kerir have more than doubled. The crude is mostly from Saudi Arabia, according to Kpler.

item.title: Japan wholesale inflation eases slightly to 7.2%, undershooting expectations
item.description: The PPI reading was lower than the 7.4% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and was down from a revised 7.3% seen in June.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz ship traffic near three-month low as U.S.-Iran deal in doubt
item.description: Traffic is about 90% lower than the daily average of 130 ships that transited Hormuz before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: Investors question data center loan valuations after latest Nvidia financing move
item.description: Data center loans are much more complex than mortgages and auto loans, investors caution

item.title: 'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
item.description: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.

item.title: Ford says it's increasing Lincoln production in the U.S. in 2030
item.description: Ford said on Wednesday that it will be increasing production of its Lincoln cars in the U.S. beginning in 2030.

item.title: Why the historic U.S.-Japan intervention has failed to halt the yen’s slide
item.description: The Japanese yen has erased about half of the gains from an unprecedented U.S.-Japan intervention less than two weeks ago.

item.title: Here are five key takeaways from the July CPI inflation report
item.description: Readings for July on the prices consumers pay for goods and services came in pretty much on target.

item.title: Trump sued over Truth Social advance access sale
item.description: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, notes that Trump's posts on his own social media site often move financial markets.

item.title: CoreWeave counters a key bear case on the AI trade. What it means for our data center stocks
item.description: CoreWeave is seeing strong demand for six-year-old Nvidia chips, helping justify all the current AI capex.

item.title: Half of Americans would struggle if their paycheck was a week late. 4 tips for managing a cash crunch
item.description: If missing a paycheck would wreak havoc on your finances, here are a few tips to help bridge the gap.

item.title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
item.description: The China Passenger Car Association released data Tuesday showing penetration of new energy vehicles rose in July. Tesla's Model Y remained popular.

item.title: SpaceX short sellers are running out of bullets as stock rebounds more than 40% off low
item.description: Short interest in SpaceX fell to about 11% of the company's publicly traded shares Wednesday, down sharply from a peak of 34% last week, according to S3.

item.title: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July, as expected, putting the annual rate at 3.4%
item.description: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.1% in July, with an annual rate of 3.4%.

item.title: Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner buy Los Angeles Lakers at a $12.5 billion valuation, source says
item.description: Venture capital founder Joshua Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger acquire Mark Walter's stake in Los Angeles Lakers at valuation of more than $12 billion.

item.title: China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus makes first international flight — could COMAC challenge the aviation duopoly?
item.description: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.

item.title: Trump officials float cut to capital gains tax on home sales. What it could mean for homeowners
item.description: Trump officials may be considering a tax break for homeowners selling their primary residence in the lead up to the midterm elections.

item.title: Where gold price is headed next as Fed rate hike and inflation odds change direction
item.description: Gold prices have been volatile in 2026, but a recent rally shows renewed investor interest amid tamer inflation data and changing Fed rate expectations.

item.title: The stock market's tranquility is almost unprecedented. That's a red flag for Michael Burry
item.description: The high-profile investor said major market cycles can take months or even years to unfold, making timing them dangerous for investors using leverage.
